ideas.idea: Show FAQ answers as visible text on the home page, not only in JSON-LD
ideas.why: index.astro only emits the FAQ in JSON-LD, so answers like the May–September water taxi season aren't readable on the page.

ideas.idea: Add visible mooring sizes and seasonal prices table on /moorings
ideas.why: The meta description promises sizes and seasonal prices but the page has only one price line.

ideas.idea: Add LocalBusiness markup for phone, address and hours on contact page
ideas.why: The page is noindex and has no address or hours yet, so the markup would add little.

ideas.idea: Add meta charset and viewport tags and a <main> element
ideas.why: Base.astro lacks charset and viewport tags and no page has <main>, which affects mobile rendering and parsing.

ideas.idea: Set the Astro `site` config and build canonicals and sitemap from it
ideas.why: There is no astro.config and harbor.example is hardcoded, so one source of truth would fix the canonical and sitemap handling.
With three pages it has little effect, and the report itself says to add it only if real dates exist.

ideas.idea: Link in body text from the home page to /moorings
ideas.why: index.astro mentions moorings with no in-content link, so only the nav leads to /moorings.

ideas.idea: Add author and date to the Article JSON-LD
ideas.why: This is a standard schema suggestion with little effect on a prices page.
